messages:
maria: kicking off canary for rw-model-2.1 — low risk, small audience.
maria: applying flag `feature/model_canary_rw-model-2.1` -> ON
maria: spec: 2% traffic, region filter: us-east-1, user_tier: free+beta
devin: do we have guardrails? latency and 5xx thresholds?
sasha: suggest: rollback if 99th latency > 350ms or 5xx rate > 0.4% over 5m
ryan: also watch token-cost variance > +20% and embedding-quality regressions
maria: set dashboard and alerts, creating DD monitor + trace sample. I'll post links
maria: rollout command:
```
redwoodctl feature toggle --flag feature/model_canary_rw-model-2.1 --on --percent 2 --regions us-east-1 --meta '{"duration_min":30}'
```
kevin: can we scope by canary audience? only sessions with header `x-canary=rw-qa` for now
maria: ok will add header filter to the flag targeting; update in 5
oncall-bot: [automated] monitor-rule created: dd:rw_model_canary_rw-model-2.1_errors, threshold: 0.4%
devin: reminder to add an opt-out: `feature/model_canary_rw-model-2.1.enabled=false` at org-level
sasha: once 30m stable, plan to ramp to 10% over 1hr, then to 50% next day if green
ryan: +1 on ramp plan. Please annotate the rollout channel and add canary check run id
maria: added run id: canary-1748123467; logging sample ids -> dd link: https://app.datadoghq.com/dash/dashboard/rdw-canary?canary=1748123467
kevin: code-review pinged @eng-runtime for the flag predicate change
maria: starting canary now
maria: (update) 5m in: 99p latency 320ms, 5xx 0.05%, token-cost +3% — holding
devin: looks good. Keep a 30m watch. If anything spikes, manual rollback with `redwoodctl feature toggle --flag feature/model_canary_rw-model-2.1 --off`
oncall-bot: [automated] alert suppressed until 1748123800 per maintenance window
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
